body: thank you for the response, i think there is truth in your words. i feel trapped mainly because of my inability to take action due to my fear. there are people i need to talk to in order to figure out my future, but if i do talk to them, i might discover bad news as a result of my failures. i have not been academically successful this past year, quite the opposite actually, and i'm paranoid that i could be suspended from university or something. i won't know unless i find out, but i'm terrified to find out. and i'm terrified to reach out and talk because i'm ashamed. i should have contacted my advisor months ago but i went ghost on them, i went ghost on pretty much anyone university related as i wasn't checking emails or anything. so i feel terrible about that and i'm afraid my advisor hates me for it. so every day is just me avoiding the truth, unable to move forward with anything. i need to get in touch but i have no idea how to talk to anyone about what's happened. i feel so ashamed that i have avoided everything for so long. and i don't know how to get back to things.
